title: Winner's press conference
message: Winner's presser in ten minutes. They'll ask if you're ready for the next step. How do you want to play it?

hint: Headlines, and a few raised eyebrows

title: A retirement
message: Tough one. Before the debrief I need to hear what happened out there.
hint: Morale takes a hit, the team respects it

reply: Say nothing, go to the simulator

title: {mate} beat you
message: {mate} was ahead again. The data says you're losing it in the slow corners. Want to go through it?

reply: Ask for a different setup direction
hint: Your engineer may or may not agree
failed_text: {engineer} thinks it's you, not the car.

title: Team-mate tension
message: {mate} isn't happy after today. Keep it professional this week, okay?

title: The overtake everyone's talking about
message: Your move into the last chicane is everywhere. Two million views and climbing. Post the onboard?

title: {rival} has something to say
message: Heads up: {rival} just told reporters you're dangerous in the braking zones. They want a reaction.

title: {boss} wants a word
message: Motorhome, after the briefing. We need more from you.

worked_text: {boss} agrees to look at the car.

title: Simulator day
message: There's a free simulator slot at the factory this week. Want it?

title: Dinner with {engineer}
message: A few of us are getting dinner tonight. You in?

title: A setup argument
message: Saw your note about more front wing. I don't agree: it'll eat the rears.
worked_text: You were right. The car feels great.
failed_text: It didn't work. {engineer} is not impressed.

title: Factory visit
message: The factory staff would love to see you this week. Can you come by and say thanks?

title: {agent} has a plan
message: We need to talk about the next two years. Call me when you're out of the car.
hint: Fame, the team hears about it

title: Social media
message: Someone dug up a video of you karting at nine. It's going viral.

title: Fan event
message: About three hundred fans in your colours at the gate, asking for autographs. Prep starts in an hour.

reply: Half an hour, then back to work

title: Charity karting race
message: A children's charity wants you at their karting day. They'd love a donation too. Good cause.

title: Big interview
message: A big magazine wants a long sit-down. They'll ask about your future.

hint: Headlines; the team may not like it

title: Money is tight
message: I looked at your account. Junior racing is eating it. We need to sort this.

title: Home
message: We haven't seen you since the winter. Come home for a weekend?

title: Fitness camp
message: I want you at altitude camp for a week. Your neck strength is behind where it should be.

title: Doubts
message: You're not sleeping before races, are you? I can tell. We should talk.

title: A former champion calls
message: This is a former world champion. I've been watching your onboards. I could coach you for a few weekends, if you want.

title: Paddock rumour
message: The paddock's saying another team wants you next year. Your boss has heard it too.

title: Can I come?
message: Can I come to the next race? I've never seen you do it up close.
reply: Of course, I'll sort a pass
Not this one, it's a big weekend

title: We never see each other
message: We never see each other. Are we doing this or not?

title: A favour
message: Don't laugh. I got into a design course but it's $20K. Could you help?

title: Mum wants to come
message: Your dad and I want to watch a race from the grandstand this year. Which one is best?

reply: Watch at home, it's better on TV

title: Problem at the {rental}
message: The tenants at the {rental} say the boiler's gone. Do we fix it properly?

title: Simulator night
message: Coming over for a sim battle tonight? Loser buys dinner.

title: Pole position
message: You took pole. The written press want two minutes before parc ferme closes.

title: Points on the board
message: We saw you score. Your dad has already told the whole street.

reply: Send a photo from the garage

title: A hard weekend
message: You looked frustrated after the race. Are you eating properly?

title: We saw the car stop
message: The pictures showed you walking back. Call us so we know you're alright.

title: Tyre temperatures
message: Your front left was ten degrees hot by lap twelve. I want to change the pressures for next week.

reply: Ask to see the data first

title: The sponsors noticed
message: Podium. Two sponsors called me before you were out of the car. Well done.

reply: Ask what it means for next year

title: A watch brand
message: A watch brand wants you on a billboard. The money is small. The logo is not.

worked_text: They came back with a better number.

title: I watched every lap
message: I watched every lap. I'm proud of you. Call me when the noise stops.

title: Don't tell Mum
message: I bet my mate you'd score points. He owes me dinner. Don't tell Mum.

title: Drinks when you're back
message: Saw you beat {mate}. Drinks this week or are you too important now?

title: Your neck
message: That stop will sit in your neck for a week. Ice tonight. No simulator tomorrow.

title: The stewards' note
message: The stewards' note is out. Reporters want a line on {rival} before you leave the track.

failed_text: The onboard does not. The team is unhappy.

title: Time left in Q2
message: We left time on the table in Q2. I want ten minutes before dinner.

worked_text: He nods. The traffic was the story.
failed_text: He already has the data. It was you.

title: The board asked
message: The board asked about you today. I told them you are staying. I hope that was right.

title: A reserve seat
message: An F1 team might need a reserve next year. Nothing is firm. We should be ready.

title: You've gone quiet
message: You've gone quiet since the race. Talk to me?

title: A proper meal
message: The season is nearly done. Come home and eat something that is not from a hospitality tent.

title: Watching it again
message: I recorded the race. We are watching your win again tonight. Mum cried.

title: Indoor karting
message: Karting night at the indoor track. Are you coming or are you too famous now?

title: Four hundred grams
message: You are four hundred grams over the target. Cut the snacks this week.
